write_protocol.who_writes: All agents append entries for their actions. QA appends entries for commits and gate results.

format.agent: Role name of the acting agent
format.action: Brief description of what was done

write_protocol.review: Owner may review ledger at any time. QA reviews ledger as part of commit preparation.
